uart.signal: committed ELF fixture (tests/fixtures/microbit-v1-smoke.elf, from crates/firmware-nrf51822-demo) linked at the S110 application base 0x18000 and run with no SoftDevice; assert_uart_contains matches 'OK\n' on a real bus.attach_uart_tx_sink capture. The bytes go through UART0 as the nRF51 legacy UART (PSELTXD = P0.24, BAUDRATE, ENABLE = 4, STARTTX, then TXD + EVENTS_TXDRDY per byte). Fixture absence is a hard assert!, not a skip.
uart.lane: core-ci / pr-gate: cargo test -p labwired-core --test firmware_survival (also rebuilt from source by core-coverage-matrix-smoke / coverage-matrix-microbit-v1)
uart.note: thin but real: three bytes through the legacy UART path. The official MakeCode images print over the same model under crates/core/examples/sd_hle_run.rs, which no test asserts.

spi.gap: The descriptor declares i2c0 (the SPI0/TWI0 mux, shared nRF52 serial model), but no firmware or harness on this chip drives SPI.

i2c.gap: The descriptor declares i2c0 (SPI0/TWI0 mux) and twi1 (shared nRF52 TWIM model), but no firmware or harness on this chip drives I2C.
